name: Otto Kernberg
shortBio: Austrian-American psychoanalyst and psychiatrist who synthesized Kleinian object relations with Freudian ego psychology to develop structural diagnostic criteria for Borderline Personality Organization and Transference-Focused Psychotherapy.
centralQuestion: How do primitive defense mechanisms like splitting and projective identification prevent the integration of good and bad internal object representations in severe personality pathology?

keyWorks.title: Borderline Conditions and Pathological Narcissism
keyWorks.description: Pioneering clinical treatise defining borderline structural organization and differentiating narcissism from neurotic pathology.

keyWorks.title: Internal World and External Reality: Object Relations Theory Applied
keyWorks.description: Synthesizes drive theory, internalized object relations, and affective neuroscience into personality structure.

keyWorks.title: Severe Personality Disorders: Psychotherapeutic Strategies
keyWorks.description: Outlines clinical strategies, setting boundaries, and interpreting primitive transferences in severe character disorders.
